calendar_features.name: is_holiday
calendar_features.definition: 1 on an actual-date US federal holiday in the locked calendar, otherwise 0; observed substitute weekdays are not added

history_features.name: lag_1
history_features.definition: pickup count for the same zone in the previous 4-hour block

history_features.name: lag_6
history_features.definition: pickup count for the same zone in the same block on the previous day

history_features.name: lag_42
history_features.definition: pickup count for the same zone in the same block on the previous week

history_features.name: lag_84
history_features.definition: pickup count for the same zone in the same block two weeks earlier

history_features.name: lag_168
history_features.definition: pickup count for the same zone in the same block four weeks earlier

history_features.name: seasonal_mean_4w
history_features.definition: mean of the same zone-time block over the previous four weeks

history_features.name: recent_mean_6
history_features.definition: mean of the previous six completed blocks for the same zone

history_features.name: recent_mean_42
history_features.definition: mean of the previous 42 completed blocks for the same zone

history_features.name: recent_std_42
history_features.definition: population standard deviation of the previous 42 completed blocks for the same zone

models.name: polynomial_regression_degree_2
models.retention_rule: retain only if residual curvature gate passes, mean MAE is at least 1 percent below the best non-polynomial regression, and all global model-selection rules pass

preprocessing.numeric_imputation: none; score only rows where the locked common feature set is complete
preprocessing.standard_scaling: fit_on_fold_training_only for Ridge and polynomial numeric terms
preprocessing.prediction_postprocessing: clip predictions below zero to zero before every metric

validation.within_validation_update: model parameters stay fixed within a fold; lag and rolling inputs are refreshed from actual pickup history after each completed block
validation.common_sample_rule: all baselines and candidate models are compared on identical validation rows where every locked feature is available

segments.activity_tier: within each fold, rank zones by target sum using only that fold's training rows and split into three equal-count groups Low, Medium, High
segments.peak_period: within each fold, use training rows only to rank the 42 day-of-week x block-hour cells; the top 14 cells by mean target are Peak and the remaining 28 are Off-peak
segments.weekday_weekend: Saturday and Sunday are Weekend; Monday through Friday are Weekday
segments.borough: fixed lookup metadata; evaluation only, not a model feature
segments.target_state: Zero when observed target equals zero; Positive otherwise; evaluation only

rules: candidate mean MAE across four folds must be lower than previous_week mean MAE
candidate must beat previous_week MAE in at least three of four folds
candidate mean Low-tier MAE must not exceed 1.05 times previous_week mean Low-tier MAE
model_selection.tie_breaker: choose the simpler model; if complexity is equal, choose lower mean RMSE
model_selection.ridge_alpha_selection: choose the alpha with the lowest unweighted mean MAE across the same four development folds; break ties with the larger alpha
model_selection.polynomial_curvature_gate: using pooled out-of-fold predictions from the best non-polynomial regression, split predictions into ten equal-frequency bins; pass only when at least three bins have absolute mean residual at least 10 percent of global MAE and the qualifying residuals include both signs

excluded_features.reason: occur during or after the target block
occur during or after the target block and are unavailable for zero-demand cells
contain the target or future values
fold_1 training has no rows with this feature available
deterministic from zone_id and retained only for segment evaluation
not present in the locked data source and event outcomes may be unknown at prediction time
would fit preprocessing on future outcomes
